newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight rates soften in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight rates soften in liquid market.

text.p: * Central Bank maintains overnight lending at 15 pct
Philippine overnight money further mellowed to an average of 11.50 percent on Wednesday from 13.9375 after banks regained their liquid positions following more than a week of tightness, traders said.
"There was so much money. At the end of the session, banks were even willing to lend at 1/16 above the Central Bank's overnight borrowing rate of 11 percent," a foreign bank dealer said.
Banks are preparing their liquidity positions in view of the high demand for pesos for Christmas spending in the next few weeks, one dealer said.
Traders said the three-month bill was quoted an offer rate of 11.55 to 11.70 percent; the six months at 11.80 to 12.375; and the one year at 12.60 to 12.75 percent.
